title: Item 10a · The ⋯ menu: one order everywhere
subtitle: Approved in each section, so five different orders. Each section's ⋯ menu was approved on its own, and the same items sit in different places: Star moves “Edit candidate” from third to first once someone has paid; Camps puts Withdraw before the payment items; Black Belt has no payment group. Color Belt's menu — the one you picked as the model in item 4 — already keeps one order in three groups. (How admin-only items are shown — Camps' “Admin” heading — is the next question, 10b.) (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · Color Belt's order everywhere

row.caption: 7. Star, not paid: Edit details first, then its own item and Change how they'll pay.
8. Star, paid: the same first lines; the payment items and Print receipt (item 3b) get their own group.
9. Camps, paid: Edit details — payment items — Withdraw · Delete permanently. Drawn without the “Admin” heading (10b).

items.caption: 10. Black Belt, with items 4 and 7 added: Edit details · Change plan or Kukkiwon — Edit payment · Undo payment · Print receipt — Withdraw · Delete permanently (grayed while there are payment records).

columns.note: The rule — three groups, always in this order: (1) about the person: Edit details first, then the section's own items (Move to / Set private testing, Change plan or Kukkiwon, Change day or time, Grade), Change how they'll pay, Review possible duplicate; (2) money: Edit payment, Undo payment, refunds, Print receipt; (3) taking someone off: Withdraw (or Cancel private testing), then Delete permanently, last and red. Items that don't apply are left out; the rest never move. The same words everywhere (“Edit details”). Pictures 7–10 are drawn over the real menus; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − the same item is in a different place in each section — even on two rows of the same Star roster — so he can't learn where things are.
B · Recommended: Color Belt's order everywhere (pictures 7–10). Three groups — about the person, money, taking someone off — in a fixed order; items that don't apply are left out and the rest never move; “Edit details” everywhere (Star's “Edit candidate” renamed). + every roster's menu looks the same: Edit details always on top, money always in the middle, Delete permanently always last and red; it's the model you picked in item 4. − small rework in Star and Camps; Color Belt private testing moves “Change how they'll pay” below its own items; Black Belt's menu changes anyway with items 4 and 7.
C · “Most likely first”. The item he'll most likely need goes on top, so the order changes with the row — what Star and Camps do on unpaid rows today. + the likely next step is one line higher. − items move between rows, so he can't build a habit; the opposite of one fixed menu.
